verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth's own docs say it can add a TOTP second factor (or phone) to user sign-in, which covers the core authenticator-app MFA part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows backup or recovery codes, a way to require MFA for all users, or step-up enforcement. Missing for 10: backup/recovery codes, documented MFA enforcement/requirement policy, step-up authentication enforcement, in-depth MFA docs and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: Add a second factor to user sign-in with TOTP or phone.
